# Amp Suite — cab IR provenance

**Status:** factory cabs are generated by minimum-phase magnitude synthesis
from grouped, level-normalized reference captures. Reference WAVs are never
shipped.

## Policy

- TONE3000 reference captures are used only as **analysis targets**.
- Reference WAVs live in `refs/irs/` and are gitignored. They must not appear
  in the repository, release tarball or plugin binary.
- No bulk download, scrape, mirror or cache of TONE3000. The user downloads
  references manually.
- Generated factory IRs are original works synthesized from the model and are
  licensed **CC0**. The model/fitter is GPL-3.0-or-later.
- The plugin never fetches, uploads or shares user IRs.

TONE3000's T3K license permits downloading and using the file in software, but
not redistributing it without the author's permission. That is why the
references stay out of the release.

### Mesa OS notes

- The target is the **Rectifier Standard / oversized** cab, not the smaller
  Traditional.
- Late-90s/early-00s UK-spec Vintage 30 voicing: warmer low-mids, smoother
  3–5 kHz, less fizz than modern Chinese V30s.
- Cross-checks: [2000s straight](https://www.tone3000.com/tones/mesa-os-4x12-ir-1612),
  [SM57/SM58/KSM313](https://www.tone3000.com/tones/mesa-4x12-oversized-rectifier-standard-shure-sm57-sm58-ksm313-irs-6271).
- Exclude the 2012/2013 OS cab and the 2002 Traditional.
- Used by Block 120 (alternate) and Recto (default).

## Generation

References are grouped per cabinet and mic character:

```
refs/irs/<amp>/57/*.wav      dynamic close-mic set
refs/irs/<amp>/121/*.wav     ribbon / darker set
refs/irs/<amp>/blend/*.wav   multi-mic / blended set
```

Each group is level-normalized in the 100 Hz–8 kHz band, smoothed to
1/12-octave and averaged in dB. The Recto groups use `weights.json`: the 1993
oversized cab is the anchor and the 2002 capture is a lower-weight cross-check.

`tools/ir_synth.py` then:

```
grouped refs  →  trim/resample → |H(f)| → 1/12-octave → weighted mean
  →  minimum-phase real-cepstrum synthesis
  →  25 Hz high-pass, 20 kHz low-pass, 256-sample tail fade
  →  peak-normalize  →  48k/96k 24-bit WAV + manifest
```

The minimum-phase method retains far more detail than the earlier 30-parameter
parametric fit. `tools/ir_fit.py` remains available for parametric experiments,
and `tools/ir_validate.py` provides an independent 1/6-octave comparison plot.

Self-test: `tools/ir_synth.py --self-test` synthesizes a known target and
recovers it at ~0.02 dB mean / 0.23 dB max error.

Outputs per amp: `cab_<amp>_57`, `cab_<amp>_121`, `cab_<amp>_blend`;
48 kHz (2048 taps) and 96 kHz (4096 taps), minimum-phase, no added latency.

## Acceptance

- 1/12-octave target error within ±1 dB mean and ±3 dB max, 100 Hz–8 kHz.
- Cab band preserved without a synthetic-sounding peak or notch.
- Low-frequency rolloff does not create a DC component or excessive subsonic
  energy.
- Blind A/B: same cab family and mic character, not a copy of a reference.
- 2048 taps at 48 kHz / 4096 at 96 kHz, minimum-phase, zero added latency.


## Generated factory set (0.2.0)

| Cab | Generated files | Target mean / max error (57) | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Chorus Clean | `assets/irs/chorus-clean/` | 0.12 / 1.00 dB | JC-120 2×12, C414 / C636 |
| Chime | `assets/irs/chime/` | 0.19 / 1.14 dB | AC30 alnico 2×12, E906 |
| Crunch | `assets/irs/crunch/` | 0.27 / 2.11 dB | Orange 4×12 V30, dynamic + ribbon blend |
| Hot Rod | `assets/irs/hot-rod/` | 0.20 / 1.47 dB | Marshall 1960 G12T-75, SM57 / SM58 |
| Block 120 | `assets/irs/block-120/` | 0.20 / 1.20 dB | Peavey 412MS Sheffield 1290, 57 / AR5 / mixes |
| Stealth EL34 | `assets/irs/stealth/` | 0.18 / 1.82 dB | EVH 5150III G12-EVH, close/far SM57 |
| Recto / OS | `assets/irs/recto/` | 0.15 / 0.92 dB | 1993 OS anchor + 2002 cross-check |

Each set contains `57`, `121` and `blend` variants at 48 kHz (2048 taps) and
96 kHz (4096 taps). The engine normalizes each IR to unity at 1 kHz so cab and
mic switching stays level-consistent; the cab level control still trims the
final level.

The Mesa OS set is shared by the Recto default and the Block 120 alternate.
The Block 120 default remains the Sheffield 1290 cab.

The aggregate manifest is `assets/irs/manifest.json`; per-cab manifests record
the reference groups, weights, target EQ, synthesis method and error metrics.

## Manifest

`assets/irs/manifest.json` records, per output: model version, synthesis
method, reference groups and weights, target EQ, error metrics, reference
URLs, license (T3K) and generation date. `assets/irs/LICENSE` is CC0.

## Release gate

No T3K WAV in the repository or tarball. No network in package install
scripts. The user IR folder is `~/.local/share/amp-suite/irs/user/`; the plugin
only reads local files.
